description: This file defines the ShadingRenderer class responsible for rendering shading styles onto a PDF graphics context using the PdfSharp library. It includes methods for rendering shaded rectangles with optional rounded corners, and manages the creation of brushes based on shading properties.

classes.name: ShadingRenderer
classes.description: Responsible for rendering shading styles onto a PDF graphics context, including handling of rounded corners and visibility.

methods.name: ShadingRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with a graphics context and shading object, and preparing the brush.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with the shading on the graphics context at specified position and size.

methods.name: Render (with RoundedCorner)
methods.description: Draws a shaded rectangle with optional rounded corners.

methods.name: IsVisible
methods.description: Determines if the shading is visible based on its properties.

methods.name: RealizeBrush
methods.description: Creates and assigns the brush used for shading if the shading is visible.
